content: Hey team, the Apollo project alpha release date has been moved to March 15th. Please adjust your schedules accordingly.
JIRA-1234 has been assigned to Bob. The performance optimization task is critical and needs to be done by end of week.
Quick update: I've finished the database migration script. It handles both MySQL and PostgreSQL. Tests are passing.
The client meeting is scheduled for Thursday at 2pm. Carol will present the Q1 roadmap.
FYI - the Apollo alpha release date has been pushed back to March 22nd due to testing delays.
Carol mentioned that Acme Corp wants to integrate our API into their platform. She's setting up a call with their CTO next Tuesday.

We should migrate the Apollo backend from Express to Fastify. The benchmarks show 2x throughput improvement and the plugin ecosystem is mature enough now. I've already prototyped the health and ingest routes.
Reminder: the security audit for Apollo is due by March 30th. Frank from InfoSec will lead. All PRs must have threat model annotations starting next sprint.
Acme Corp's annual revenue is $450M. They have 2,000 employees and are headquartered in San Francisco. Key contact: Grace Liu, VP Engineering.
Note to self: Bob prefers async communication over meetings. He's most productive in the mornings before 11am. Timezone is PST.
JIRA-1234 status changed to In Review. Bob submitted the PR for the performance optimization. Reviewers: Alice Wang, Dave Kim.
Really frustrated with the CI pipeline. It's been flaky for two weeks and nobody is owning the fix. We've lost at least 8 hours of developer time this sprint.
Great news! The Apollo performance benchmarks are in. Response times dropped from 340ms to 95ms after Bob's optimization. Throughput is up 3.5x under load.

Action items from today's standup: 1) Bob to fix CI flakiness by Wednesday 2) Carol to finalize Acme Corp contract terms 3) Dave to set up staging environment for Apollo beta 4) Eve to draft the partner API documentation.
Correction: the Apollo alpha release is actually March 15th as originally planned. Dave's earlier message was based on outdated info from the old sprint board. I confirmed with the VP directly.
